provenance.construction: Single-layer weight-8 tile code: the n=512, k=8 open-boundary planar bivariate-bicycle code from research/local2d/boundary_engine.py build_planar(16, 16, S_f, S_g) with S_f = ((0,0),(1,2),(2,1),(2,2)) and S_g = ((0,2),(1,0),(1,1),(2,0)) -- both 4-subsets of a 3x3 monomial box, which is what keeps the single-layer interaction radius at 4.0 -- reduced by 20 restricted r=1 lattice grafts to n = 492. Each graft removes a qubit lying in exactly one stabilizer of one type, together with that stabilizer, and was kept only if all four held: k stayed 8; the Tanner graph stayed connected and the stabilizer group stayed one block (verify/qldpc_verify.py's own _tanner_component_count and _stabilizer_block_count); a 1500-trial gf2_fast RIS screen with seed 1 returned >= 20; and two fresh-seed 400000-trial confirms both returned >= 20. Every single removal was followed by a three-seed 100000-trial block gate that rolled the chain back below the floor. The connectivity guard is load-bearing: without it the first five removals kept k and distance but split the code, which the verifier rejects on tanner_connected + stabilizer_group_connected. LAYOUT: the unit square lattice rotated 45 degrees with the two blocks on its two sublattices, qubit (i, j, c) -> (i + j + c, j - i), the pattern codes/572-8-19.json uses; every surviving qubit keeps the coordinate it held in the source, so the layout is inherited and only deletion occurred. Measured interaction radius 4.0000, inside the local-2d-single cap; max check weight 8. Strictly dominates the board's [[511,8,20]] on n with k, d and check weight unchanged. Distance is a witness-backed upper bound: four independent deep screens totalling about 20M gf2_fast trials at pair_depth 16, 18, 24 and 32 on separate seeds all return 20.

search_budget.notes: 630 support pairs screened (k=8 is the 3x3-box ceiling); 20 r=1 grafts kept under k, connectivity and 400k-trial distance confirms; distance confirmed at ~20M trials across 4 pair_depths
